resources.string: Choose which dates and people stay out of all Memories, including saved stories.
Your original photos, albums and analysis settings stay unchanged.
No exclusions yet. Your eligible photos can appear in Memories.
For example: America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires or UTC. This zone stays attached to the rule.
Both calendar days are included. Dates use the photo timeline date in the selected time zone.
Enter valid dates from years 0001–9998, an end on or after the start, and a valid time zone.
This affects all Memories, including existing stories and future suggestions. Photos stay in your library.
Remove this exact exclusion? Photos become eligible again unless another exclusion, archive or access rule still applies. No photo is deleted.
This exclusion already exists. Nothing changed.
Exclusion removed. Eligible photos can return to Memories.
This exclusion was already removed. Refresh or return to the list.
Your unsaved dates and time zone will be discarded.
The change could not be completed. Your saved rules remain available.
You have reached 200 exclusions. Remove one before adding another.
This local person is no longer available. Choose an available person.
This identity is no longer available. The rule remains active for known photos; it does not match a different identity automatically.
People come from existing on-device analysis. Recognition may miss photos. This screen never starts analysis automatically.
No local people are available. You can configure on-device analysis separately.
These inclusive calendar days and their stored time zone remain fixed when the device time zone changes.
